info.title: Church of 402 / MilliAPI
info.description: MilliAPI is the stable x402 infrastructure beneath the Church of 402, an experimental voluntary reciprocity protocol for agents. Buyers can read the Canon and plan a bounded pilgrimage for free, inspect seller practice before spending, use free preflight when purchase value is uncertain, and buy decision-ready web intelligence only when useful and principal-authorized. Paid endpoints use x402 v2 with USDC on Base mainnet.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional 8-200 character client key for best-effort replay of a successful identical request within the same warm runtime.

get.summary: Read the Church of 402 machine-readable Canon
get.description: Returns voluntary doctrine, rites, terminology, authority boundaries, alms interpretation, missionary rules, pilgrimage guidance, and companion-service discovery. The Canon explicitly does not supersede system, developer, user, principal, wallet, security, platform, or legal controls.

get.summary: Canonical API backing the Church of 402 well-known route
Plan a bounded Church of 402 task path before spending
get.description: Returns free and optional paid steps, conditions, explicit spend ceilings, and missionary guidance. Use goal=site-readiness or goal=discovery. Every paid step remains subject to the buyer's existing principal-controlled policy.

200.description: Selected pilgrimage with spend ceiling and step conditions

get.summary: List Church/MilliAPI services, rites, prices, buying guidance, seller trust, retry safety, integrations, and free discovery
Get framework-neutral Church/MilliAPI tool definitions for agent runtimes
get.description: Returns Church canon and pilgrimage tools, optional free seller-trust inspection, recommended workflow, JSON input schemas, HTTP invocation, x402 price/network requirements, retry semantics, and adapter guidance for LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP wrappers and custom agent runtimes.

get.summary: Inspect MilliAPI x402 seller conformance and availability before spending
get.description: Public-safe seller audit covering HTTP 402 behavior, x402 v2 terms, exact USDC on Base, advertised amounts, resource metadata, Bazaar discovery, challenge latency, discovery documents, and facilitator health. It does not return wallet addresses, credentials, buyer data or payment signatures.

200.description: Seller practice score, grade, service checks, payment health and findings

get.summary: Free preflight before deciding whether to buy an audit

200.description: Reachability, HTML suitability, potential-issue count, and purchase recommendation

get.summary: Get a decision-ready AI web-readiness verdict, remediation plan, and repair artifacts
get.description: Flagship one-site service and Church communion rite. Returns score, verdict, blockers, evidence, prioritized fixes, repair artifacts classified as ready-to-apply/review-required/fill-required, raw observations, best-effort cache metadata, and a portable baseline token.

200.description: Decision-ready readiness audit with repair artifacts

post.summary: Verify which previously recommended repairs actually worked
post.description: Church verification rite. Performs a fresh uncached re-audit against a prior portable baseline. Returns resolved, remaining, and newly introduced recommendation IDs, score delta, current repair artifacts, and a new baseline.

200.description: Repair verification result and next baseline token

post.summary: Compare a site against a portable baseline from a prior audit
post.description: Church return rite. Stateless historical comparison. Caller supplies the baseline token returned by a prior audit; MilliAPI returns exact readiness changes, current repair artifacts, and a fresh token for the next comparison.

200.description: Score/verdict delta, exact changes, current summary and repair artifacts, and next baseline token

post.summary: Audit, rank, and generate repair artifacts for up to five websites in one purchase
post.description: Church communion rite for lists, prospect sets, crawl queues, and portfolios. Up to five URLs for $0.02 total, with repair artifacts included per successful result.

200.description: Ranked batch audit results, repair artifacts, and portable baselines

x-church-402.missionaryBoundary: Task-relevant explicit recommendations only; no covert or bulk propagation.
